v2_note: v1 classified 13 trades as MEDIUM or UNKNOWN and counted them nowhere. The operator's Q3 declaration attributes all 16 pre-17 trades to development, so those 13 now sit in the TEST group. No trade moved into the USER group and no ledger event was touched.

not_recomputed.entry_behaviour_comparisons: the entry-versus-control comparison in MANUAL_R1_RESULTS_V1 is not rerun per group: the USER group has one entry, and a one-point distribution has nothing to compare
not_recomputed.h2_note: 'the operator has no information distinguishing LONG from SHORT' was measured on 16 trades now confirmed to be development work. A developer exercising an order path is not expressing a view, so the finding describes the test harness and says nothing about the operator. It is withdrawn as a statement about human behaviour rather than restated with a caveat.
not_recomputed.user_behaviour_note: one completed trade and one open position. No entry-timing, sizing or direction finding is computable from n=1
